decisions.notes: Coherent mid-century armchair from all eight orbits, top and bottom. Leather cushions and oak frame read clearly; 2K PBR maps are intact, UVs present, no degenerate triangles and no validator errors.
limitations: Generated tangent-space warnings are informational; target engines may generate tangents on import.
Static inspection only; no collision mesh or LODs are supplied.

decisions.notes: Terracotta pot, soil and leafy plant remain coherent from every angle. Leaf alpha and pot roughness read correctly in the corrected framing. High triangle count and a small number of zero-area leaf triangles are acceptable for a realistic hero prop, not a mobile crowd asset.
limitations: 176,226 triangles and 132 zero-area triangles; use LODs or decimation for performance-sensitive scenes.
Leaf cards rely on alpha testing/blending in the target engine.

decisions.notes: Stylized knight with helmet, cape, sword and shield reads cleanly from all sides after hidden-helper exclusion. Atlas texture is intact, rig has 41 bones, no zero-area triangles and no validator errors. Strong fit for kids'/stylized game scenes.
limitations: Skinned-mesh non-root and buffer-view-target warnings are importer/optimizer notes, not visual defects.
Animation clips must be tested in the target engine; inspection used rest pose.

decisions.notes: Mini female character is now correctly framed and readable from every orbit. Simple flat-color atlas, clean low-poly silhouette, 7-bone rig and no degenerate triangles. Appropriate as a lightweight kids'/prototype human variant alongside realistic humans.
limitations: 512px flat-color atlas rather than PBR maps; intentionally low-poly.
Unused-object/tangent and skinned-mesh warnings are non-visual validator notes.

decisions.notes: Low-poly hatchback is complete from front, back, sides, top and underside. Wheels, windows and lights are coherent; flat-color atlas suits the stylized vehicle category. Eight zero-area triangles are minor and do not affect the visible silhouette.
limitations: Flat-color atlas rather than PBR maps.
Eight zero-area triangles retained from upstream; no validator errors.
